digest.component_or_area: Jira family adapter user identity model
propositions: PR #120 hardcoded is_account_id=False and relied on unreachable getattr(_assignee_resolver) attribute, causing DC to permanently return authoritative=False and creating assignee-change churn on every diff pass
Cloud identifies users by opaque accountId; Data Center identifies users by name, requiring different resolution logic and payload shapes in OutboundMapper and transport layers

A UserIdentityModel protocol with resolve(local_value, remote_identity) returning (value, authoritative, is_account_id) tuple and to_payload(value) for deployment-specific assignee shapes must be defined with Cloud and DC implementations
NameIdentity must perform real lookup against DC user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True for resolvable assignees, preventing diff convergence failure
An unresolvable assignee must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError rather than silently returning non-authoritative resolution
